name: Jasmine Ortiz

five_sec.what_is_it: an app that picks dinners and puts the groceries in ur walmart cart
five_sec.trust_why: free no card + powered by instacart, seems legit
five_sec.delivers_food_why: it literally says 'We don't deliver food' lol

full_page.what_stopped_me: nothing really. but it never says if i can pay w EBT when it puts stuff in my walmart cart, and nothing about baby/toddler food. the sample week is $64 which is like most of my week
full_page.whats_missing: EBT/SNAP answer, toddler-friendly dinners, using WIC stuff i already have

DD.quote: ok 'start free, no card needed' i'm tapping. but does the walmart cart work w my EBT?? it doesn't say anywhere

five_sec.trust_why: free meals sounds good ngl but the box game is sus
five_sec.delivers_food_why: the green hellofresh boxes, it's food shipped to u

full_page.what_stopped_me: have to put my zip just to see prices, tiny print says auto-renewing subscription and shipping after the first box. can't use EBT on that

HF.quote: 10 free meals had me for a sec then the tiny print said auto-renewing and shipping after the first box. nope

five_sec.who_for: moms w little kids, cute pic
five_sec.delivers_food_why: it's a phone w a list

full_page.what_stopped_me: it's 'Try Free for 14 Days' and they don't say what it costs after. FREE grocery pickup and the walmart logo are nice tho

EM.quote: free grocery pickup and big walmart logo is cute but it's a 14 day trial and they don't even say the price after

five_sec.delivers_food_why: app store buttons, recipes and lists

full_page.what_stopped_me: u save the recipes urself and then pay $5.95 a month

PTE.quote: i'd have to find the recipes myself on tiktok and then pay $5.95?? i already do the tiktok part for free lol

five_sec.delivers_food_why: the phone says 'Tonight's dinner is a good one' like it's coming to me

full_page.whats_missing: a real free plan for meals

OL.quote: one review says 'working mom of a toddler' which is me but $25 a month?? that's like 3 days of groceries

dd_offer.why: i saw 'free' and tapped, didn't really read the 14 days part
dd_offer.expect_day_15: idk it'll probably ask me to pay and i'll just stop using it

head_to_head.reason: only one that's actually $0 and works w walmart

EM.reason: free forever vs a trial w no price

PTE.reason: it gives me the dinners, i don't have to find them

HF.reason: i shop at walmart w my EBT, no boxes

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Home page FAQ ('Questions parents ask'): add 'Can I use EBT/SNAP?' with a straight answer about paying at Walmart checkout, plus a toddler-friendly sample week.
